result: Full-batch GD on neural networks first sharpens (top Hessian eigenvalue rises) and then trains at the edge of stability: the sharpness hovers at 2/η and the loss falls non-monotonically. With momentum the edge moves to (2 + 2β)/η.
result_plain: GD sharpness rises to 2/η and hovers there while loss keeps falling non-monotonically.
